enchantments.tooltip: Quality Constitution +1: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +1 Quality bonus to Constitution.
Fortification +94%: +94% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Combat Mastery +6: +6 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Insightful Doublestrike 3%: Passive: 3% Insight bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
